items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And I see Al Hibbler. I had forgotten I had recorded with him.

ctx.x: I had forgotten another Erroll Garner record when he was recording for Mercury. "Blue Skies," "Don't Blame Me," "Full Moon and Empty Arms" and "Memories Of You". What brings that to mind is Milt Holland played drums on that. That was the first time I had ever worked with Milt Holland.
And I see Al Hibbler. I had forgotten I had recorded with him. That was on Aladdin. "I Got It Bad and That Ain't Good," "How Long Blues" and "S'posin."
I've got an old, scratchy copy of that.
